module: Generic condition types for mission unlocks: never, missing, always and the combinators multiAnd / multiOr. Loaded by gameplay_missions_unlocks; each type has conditionMet(c) (returns met and optionally the list of nested results) and getLabel(c).
notes: missing is used when the condition type is unknown, and returns true (the condition is therefore considered fulfilled).
multiOr returns true if the nested list is empty; multiAnd too (no elements).
always is marked hidden = true (not shown in the UI).

missing.desc: Fallback condition for an invalid or unknown type; always true.

multiAnd.desc: Logical AND over c.nested (each sub-condition evaluated via gameplay_missions_unlocks.conditionMet). Returns met, nested. editorFunction 'displayNestedCondition'.

multiOr.desc: Logical OR over c.nested; true if the list is empty. Returns met, nested. editorFunction 'displayNestedCondition'.
